description: This file is part of the PyTorch library, specifically handling the cuDNN backend interface, including version management, availability checks, and configuration of cuDNN settings.

classes.name: CudnnModule
classes.description: A wrapper class for cuDNN configuration parameters, allowing context management and property access for cuDNN settings.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current cuDNN version if available, otherwise None.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if cuDNN is currently available in the PyTorch build.

methods.name: is_acceptable
methods.description: Determines if a given tensor is suitable for cuDNN operations based on device and dtype.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets various cuDNN configuration flags such as enabled, benchmark, deterministic, allow_tf32, and fp32_precision.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: A context manager to temporarily set cuDNN flags within a code block.
